eventDetail.scope: the International Conference on Recent Advances in Mathematics and Informatics (ICRAMI 2026) focuses on advancing both theoretical and applied research in mathematics and computer science, with an emphasis on innovative methodologies and real-world applications.  Its scope includes, but is not limited to, artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, applied mathematics, statistics, data science, computational modeling, graph theory, cryptography, and information systems, as well as emerging interdisciplinary topics that connect mathematics, computing, and intelligent systems.
